params.prompt:
Create exactly SIX complete full-body Archive Knight defense/reaction/form-swap poses in a clean 3 columns x 2 rows source sheet. References 1 and 2 are absolute identity authorities. Preserve exactly: faceless ivory crested helm; narrow cyan visor; enormous open broken-archive-arch LEFT pauldron with dark-indigo center and cyan inner seam; small RIGHT shoulder; violet sternum core; porcelain plates; deep-plum joints; short rigid split tabards; heavy boots; ONE cyan-edged archive blade physically integrated along the RIGHT forearm at constant length. Never mirror, swap, omit, duplicate or redesign asymmetrical features; never detach or turn the blade into a held sword.

Screen-right three-quarter camera, stable body/head scale, lighting and baseline. Runtime row-5 order, left-to-right top then bottom: 1 high guard using the arch pauldron and attached forearm blade; 2 precise parry with attached blade deflecting outward; 3 staggered guard-break/hit recoil with anatomy readable; 4 upright form-swap charge beginning with dim violet sternum glow; 5 stronger form-swap stance with cyan seams illuminated; 6 peak form-swap stance with compact cyan-violet aura hugging the body. Full silhouettes, effect never obscures feet or armor, generous clearance.

PROJECT MANNEQUIN STYLE LOCK: controlled dark contours, broad cel shading, clean highlights, fighting anatomy, polished anime finish. Perfectly uniform pure white background. No grid, text, labels, border, floor, shadows, scenery, extra figures/limbs, loose/second blade, shield, cape, floating armor, cropped crest/blade/feet, overlap, giant aura, photorealism, PBR, rust, grime, microtexture, painterly blur.
